$comment: Job names the panel and the request schema must agree about. The panel's normaliseJobId was widened for Japanese and the schema's jobId pattern was not, so for months the panel produced names it considered perfectly valid and the helper rejected them at the gate -- with a raw regex, to a video editor. Nothing in either suite noticed, because neither suite knew about the other. Read by engine/tests/test_helper.py and panel/test/conformance.test.js.

accept.why: the name a real edit failed on, 2026-09-04

accept.name: test２
accept.why: a full-width digit, from the same editor a week earlier

accept.why: used to arrive as '1' after stripping, and was accepted silently
